[package]
name = "adaptive-cards"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Adaptive Cards"

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path = "../../../pax-kit" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.adaptive-cards]
opt-level = 0

[package]
name = "auto-sized-containers"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Auto Sized Containers"
icon = "assets/app-icon.png"

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path="../../../pax-kit" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.auto-sized-containers]
opt-level = 0

<Group width=100% height=100%>
    <Group
        x=50%
        y=50%
        width={is_compact ? 92% : 88%}
        height={is_compact ? 88% : 80%}
        anchor=50%
        scale={(card_scale * 100)%}
    >
        // This transparent top layer makes the whole postcard one generous mouse/touch target.
        <Rectangle
            width=100%
            height=100%
            fill=rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)
            corner_radius={is_compact ? 16.0 : 22.0}
            @mouse_down=self.card_mouse_down
            @mouse_up=self.card_mouse_up
            @touch_start=self.card_touch_start
            @touch_end=self.card_touch_end
            @touch_cancel=self.card_touch_cancel
        />

        // Rust eases the seal to each new press location.
        <Group
            x={(seal_x)%}
            y={(seal_y)%}
            width={is_compact ? 82px : 104px}
            height={is_compact ? 76px : 95px}
            anchor=50%
        >
            <Image width=100% height=100% source="assets/wax-seal.png" fit=ImageFit::Fit />
        </Group>

        <Text
            id=stamp_hint
            x={is_compact ? 50% : 87%}
            y={is_compact ? 88% : 67%}
            width={is_compact ? 72% : 180px}
            height=34px
            anchor_x=50%
            text={is_sealed ? "Press anywhere to stamp again" : "Press anywhere to stamp"}
            selectable=false
        />

        <PaletteStatus
            x={is_compact ? 50% : 82%}
            y={is_compact ? 82% : 87%}
            width={is_compact ? 68% : 230px}
            height=38px
            anchor_x=50%
            is_sealed={is_sealed}
        />

        // The second Mask child is a growing stencil, so the postmark wipes left-to-right.
        <Mask
            x={(seal_x - (is_compact ? 31 : 15))%}
            y={(seal_y)%}
            width={is_compact ? 34% : 15%}
            height={is_compact ? 9% : 18%}
            anchor_y=50%
            opacity={seal_progress}
        >
            <Group width=100% height=100%>
                <Path width=100% height=100% elements=[PathElement::Point(0%, 20%), PathElement::Cubic(35%, 6%, 65%, 34%), PathElement::Point(100%, 20%)] stroke={color: rgba(19, 42, 77, 210), width: 2px} />
                <Path width=100% height=100% elements=[PathElement::Point(0%, 43%), PathElement::Cubic(35%, 29%, 65%, 57%), PathElement::Point(100%, 43%)] stroke={color: rgba(19, 42, 77, 210), width: 2px} />
                <Path width=100% height=100% elements=[PathElement::Point(0%, 66%), PathElement::Cubic(35%, 52%, 65%, 80%), PathElement::Point(100%, 66%)] stroke={color: rgba(19, 42, 77, 210), width: 2px} />
            </Group>
            <Rectangle width={(0.2 + postmark_reveal * 99.8)%} height=100% fill=BLACK />
        </Mask>

        <Image
            x={is_compact ? 78% : 87%}
            y={is_compact ? 5% : 6%}
            width={is_compact ? 28% : 15%}
            height={is_compact ? 24% : 37%}
            source="assets/moon-postage.png"
            fit=ImageFit::Fit
        />

        <Handwriter
            x={is_compact ? 50% : 52%}
            y={is_compact ? 31% : 31%}
            width={is_compact ? 82% : 62%}
            height={is_compact ? 19% : 34%}
            anchor_x=50%
            text="Hello, Pax,"
            font=HandwriterFont::HersheyScript1
            line_height=1.0
            smoothing=PathSmoothing::Strong
            stroke={
                color: rgba(18, 43, 79, 255)
                width: {is_compact ? 7px : 8px}
                cap: StrokeCap::Round
                join: StrokeJoin::Round
            }
            draw_end={greeting_progress}
        />

        <Text

            y={is_compact ? 50% : 57%}
            width={is_compact ? 54% : 44%}
            height=48px
            anchor_x=50%
            text={is_sealed ? "A little light makes the journey." : "A blank page is a place to begin."}
            selectable=false
            opacity={0.72 + seal_progress * 0.28}
        />

        // This authored radial glow works on every backend; real lights can enhance it.
        <Ellipse
            x={is_compact ? 55% : 64%}
            y={is_compact ? 64% : 68%}
            width={is_compact ? 52% : 25%}
            height={is_compact ? 22% : 32%}
            anchor=50%
            opacity={0.02 + seal_progress * 0.30}
            fill=@gradient {
                radial: {
                    start: [62%, 48%]
                    end: [62%, 48%]
                    radius: 68
                }
                0%: rgba(104, 121, 255, 170)
                42%: rgba(164, 126, 221, 72)
                100%: rgba(164, 126, 221, 0)
            }
        />

        <Image
            x={is_compact ? -4% : -3%}
            y={is_compact ? 54% : 34%}
            width={is_compact ? 42% : 28%}
            height={is_compact ? 45% : 70%}
            source="assets/botanical-collage.png"
            fit=ImageFit::Fit
        />

        <Ellipse

            width={is_compact ? 48% : 31%}
            height={is_compact ? 29% : 53%}
            fill=rgba(160, 145, 190, 96)
        />
        <Ellipse

        />

        <Rectangle

                100%: rgba(237, 220, 188, 255)
            }
            stroke={color: rgba(255, 250, 234, 180), width: 2px}
            corner_radius={is_compact ? 16.0 : 22.0}
        />
    </Group>

                    _raycastable=false/>

files.examples/src/mouse-animation/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "mouse-animation"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Mouse Animation"
icon = "assets/app-icon.png"

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path="../../../pax-kit" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.mouse-animation]
opt-level = 0
files.examples/src/mouse-animation/src/lib.pax:
<Text x=50% y=50% text="Move mouse up & down" id=text/>
<Group anchor=50% x=50% y=50% width=200% rotate=20deg>
    for i in 0..12 {
        <PathAnimation rotate={(i * 40)deg} x=50% y=50% path_config={
            amplitude: {0.03 + 0.10 * i * (i - 12.00) / 10.00}
            amplitude_ramp: {0.20 + i * 0.01}
            frequency: 2.00
            frequency_ramp: {0.10 * i}
            thickness: {0.07 - 0.01 * i / 5.00}
            thickness_ramp: {0.02 - i / 5.00 * 0.01}
            span: {0.10 + 0.10 * i / 10.00}
        } 
            t={2.00 * scroll - i / 20.00} fill={hsla(40.00 * i, 150, 160 + 5 * i, 100)}/>
    }
</Group>
<Rectangle fill=TRANSPARENT/>

@settings {
    @mount: on_mount,
    @mouse_move: on_mouse_move
    #text {
        style: {

[package]

icon = "assets/app-icon.png"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[package]
name = "pax-website"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"
description = "The Pax declarative UI language and Rust GUI framework website"
repository = "https://github.com/paxdotdev/pax"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Pax — A declarative language for native and web UI"

[package.metadata.pax.web]
title = "Pax — A declarative language for native and web UI"
favicon = "../../../pax-compiler/files/interfaces/macos/pax-app-macos/pax-app-macos/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/pax-logo-1024.png"
site_name = "Pax"
site_url = "https://pax.dev"
social_image = "pax-favicon.png"
social_image_alt = "Pax logo"

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path = "../../../pax-kit" }
living-quilt = { version = "0.38.3", path = "../living-quilt" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.pax-website]
opt-level = 0

<Group width=100% height=100%>
    <ImportSettings>
        <SiteTheme />
    </ImportSettings>
    <Stacker x=50% y=80px width={self.compact ? (100% - 40px) : 88%} autosize=true gutter=28px>
        <Text class="editorial_kicker" width=100% text="THE LANGUAGE / THE LOGIC"/>
        <Stacker width=100% autosize=true gutter=0px>
            <Text class="editorial_title" width=100% text="Describe your interface."/>
            <Text class="editorial_title" width=100% text="Power it with Rust."/>
        </Stacker>
        <Text class="editorial_lead" width={self.compact ? 100% : 82%}
            text="Pax pairs a declarative UI language with Rust application logic. Compose layout, graphics, and motion, then bring the same application to macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and the web."/>
        <Stacker width=100% autosize=true autosize_x=false autosize_y=true gutter=32px
            direction={self.compact ? StackerDirection::Vertical : StackerDirection::Horizontal}>
            <Stacker width=100% autosize=true gutter=12px>
                <Text class="editorial_subtitle" width=100% text=".pax describes the interface"/>
                <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                    text="Structure, layout, style, and motion live beside the elements they affect. Side-effect-free PAXEL expressions connect state to the scene—even when that relationship involves units, conditions, or animation."/>
            </Stacker>
            <Stacker width=100% autosize=true gutter=12px>
                <Text class="editorial_subtitle" width=100% text="Rust makes things happen"/>
                <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                    text="Handle a click. Load a file. Talk to a service. Your Rust code owns state and side effects, with the Rust ecosystem available behind it. Update a property, and Pax carries that change through the interface."/>
            </Stacker>
        </Stacker>
        <Stacker width={self.compact ? 100% : 82%} autosize=true gutter=14px>
            <Text class="editorial_subtitle" width=100% text="Think in relationships, not redraws."/>
            <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                text="Like a spreadsheet, Pax tracks what depends on what. Change an input and the dependent expressions, layout, and rendering work update. The template stays declarative; you don't write the machinery that keeps it in sync."/>
            <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                text="Then work against the real thing: hot-reload templates, inspect the running scene, capture screenshots, and drive events with pax-cli dev. The same feedback loop is available to you and your coding agent."/>
            <Text class="editorial_note" width=100%
                text="Template hot reload runs in debug builds on all current targets. Opt into Rust logic reload on web and macOS; iOS and iPadOS logic changes require a rebuild."/>
        </Stacker>
        <Link width=100% height=28px url="https://docs.pax.dev/template-language/" target=Target::New>
            <Text class="editorial_link" width=100% text="GET TO KNOW THE LANGUAGE →"/>
        </Link>
    </Stacker>
    <Rectangle class="site_rule" x=50% y={100% - 1px} width={self.compact ? (100% - 40px) : 88%} height=1px/>
    <Rectangle class="site_ink" width=100% height=100%/>
</Group>

<Group width=100% height=100%>
    <ImportSettings>
        <SiteTheme />
    </ImportSettings>
    <Stacker x=50% y=80px width={self.compact ? (100% - 40px) : 88%} autosize=true gutter=28px>
        <Text class="editorial_kicker" width=100% text="A PORTABLE RUNTIME"/>
        <Text class="editorial_title" width=100% text="One project. Native and web."/>
        <Text class="editorial_lead" width={self.compact ? 100% : 82%}
            text="Take the same Pax templates and Rust logic to macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and the browser. Share the interface model, while each platform supplies the integration it needs."/>
        <Stacker width=100% autosize=true autosize_x=false autosize_y=true gutter=32px
            direction={self.compact ? StackerDirection::Vertical : StackerDirection::Horizontal}>
            <Stacker width=100% autosize=true gutter=14px>
                <Text class="editorial_subtitle" width=100% text="Native where it matters."/>
                <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                    text="Text selection, editing, form controls, and scrolling draw on the platform's own behavior. Pax composes those native elements with rendered visuals in one coordinate space, including transforms, clipping, and motion."/>
                <Text class="editorial_note" width=100%
                    text="Build web apps from macOS, Debian/Ubuntu Linux, or Windows. Apple app targets require macOS and Xcode. Native Linux, Windows, and Android apps are not current targets."/>
            </Stacker>
            <Stacker width=100% autosize=true gutter=14px>
                <Text class="editorial_subtitle" width=100% text="Performance is part of the design."/>
                <Text class="editorial_body" width=100%
                    text="The reactive graph narrows what needs updating. The renderer retains resources, reuses work, and culls content outside the viewport. Rust gives the core runtime control over memory and execution; GPU rendering handles the visual work where supported."/>
                <Text class="editorial_note" width=100%
                    text="Apple builds use Metal-backed rendering. Web builds use WebGPU where available, with a CPU fallback. Backend-specific effects can differ; performance still needs evaluating against your app and hardware."/>
            </Stacker>
        </Stacker>
        <Link width=100% height=28px url="https://docs.pax.dev/targets-build-deploy/" target=Target::New>
            <Text class="editorial_link" width=100% text="EXPLORE TARGETS AND DEPLOYMENT →"/>
        </Link>

[package]
name = "photo-picker"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Photo Picker"

[package.metadata.pax.ios.info_plist]
NSCameraUsageDescription = "Capture photos when the camera source is selected."

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path="../../../pax-kit" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.photo-picker]
opt-level = 0

[package]
name = "route-card"
version = "0.38.3"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "run"

[package.metadata.pax]
title = "Route Card"

[dependencies]
pax-kit = { version = "0.38.3", path="../../../pax-kit" }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "run"
path = "bin/run.rs"

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.
# Build scripts and proc macros keep Cargo's unoptimized defaults.
[profile.dev]
opt-level = 1

[profile.dev.package.route-card]
opt-level = 0

    <Router>
        <Route path="/">
            if is_mobile {

# Optimize runtime dependencies while keeping application rebuilds fast.

                rotate: {

        >
            <Router>

                        <Stacker
                            width=100%
                            autosize=true
                            direction=StackerDirection::Vertical

                        >
                            <Text class="section" width=100% text="Default branch" />
                            <Text class="copy"
                                width=100%
                                text="When the scoped remainder is empty, `default=true` wins without inventing a separate optional segment feature."
                            />
                            <Text class="copy"
                                width=100%
                                text="Try `?view=api` or `#bindings` in the sidebar links. The inspector above keeps the full browser location visible while matching stays scoped."
                            />
                        </Stacker>
                    </RouteTransitionFrame>
                </Route>

                            autosize=true

                                <Text class="copy"
                                    width=100%
                                    text="This branch demonstrates `:param` capture. The nested scope sees `topic/router` while the inspector still preserves the global path, query, and fragment."
                                />
                            } else if route.params.topic_id == "expressions" {
                                <Text class="copy"
                                    width=100%
                                    text="Params are plain route data, so they compose with ordinary PAXEL conditionals and string interpolation."
                                />
                            } else {
                                <Text class="copy"
                                    width=100%
                                    text={"`" + route.params.topic_id + "` is not one of the curated guide topics, but the param still matches and renders."}
                                />
                            }

                            <Text class="copy"
                                width=100%
                                text={"Current fragment: " + (route.global_location.fragment ?? "none")}
                            />
                        </Stacker>
                    </RouteTransitionFrame>
                </Route>

                <Route path="playground/*">
                    <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                        <Stacker
                            width=100%
                            autosize=true
                            direction=StackerDirection::Vertical
                            gutter=16px
                        >
                            <Text class="section"
                                width=100%
                                text="Terminal `*` consumed the playground prefix"
                            />
                            <RouteInspector width=100% title="guide playground catch-all" />

                            <Group width=100% autosize=true autosize_x=false autosize_y=true>
                                <Router>
                                    <Route default=true>
                                        <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                                            <Text class="copy"
                                                width=100%
                                                text="The nested router now matches against the catch-all remainder. Empty remainder falls back to the playground landing page."
                                            />
                                        </RouteTransitionFrame>
                                    </Route>

                                    <Route path="tokens">
                                        <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                                            <Text class="copy"
                                                width=100%
                                                text="`tokens` is an exact nested match. `route.location` here is just `/tokens`, not the full `/guide/playground/tokens` URL."
                                            />
                                        </RouteTransitionFrame>
                                    </Route>

                                    <Route path="layers">
                                        <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                                            <Text class="copy"
                                                width=100%
                                                text="`layers` is another exact nested branch. The outer inspector shows what the catch-all consumed; this inner branch shows the reduced scope."
                                            />
                                        </RouteTransitionFrame>
                                    </Route>

                                    <Route path="*">
                                        <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                                            <Text class="copy"
                                                width=100%
                                                text="Any other tail still matches through a second terminal catch-all, which is useful for exploratory or file-like route trees."
                                            />
                                        </RouteTransitionFrame>
                                    </Route>
                                </Router>
                            </Group>
                        </Stacker>
                    </RouteTransitionFrame>
                </Route>

                <Route path="*">
                    <RouteTransitionFrame width=100%>
                        <Stacker
                            width=100%
                            autosize=true
                            direction=StackerDirection::Vertical
                            gutter=12px
                        >

                            <Text class="copy"

                                text="This branch catches unmatched guide paths after the explicit topic and playground routes have had a chance to win."
                            />
                        </Stacker>
                    </RouteTransitionFrame>
                </Route>
            </Router>
        </Group>
    </Stacker>

<Group width=100% height=100%>
    <Group
        x=50%
        y=50%
        width=100%
        height=100%
        anchor=50%
        rotate={self._twist}
        scale={[(self._growth * self._side_factor * 100)%, (self._growth * 100)%]}
    >
        for layer in self._layers {
            <Group
                x=50%
                y={50% + (self._drift + layer.drift)px}
                width=100%
                height=100%
                anchor=50%
                rotate={(layer.rotation_deg)deg}
                scale={(layer.scale * 100)%}
                opacity={layer.opacity}
            >
                for angle in self._angles {
                    <Group
                        x=50%
                        y=50%
                        width=100%
                        height=100%
                        anchor=50%
                        rotate={(angle + layer.rotation_deg * 0.4)deg}
                    >
                        if self.enable_tendrils && self.variant == KaleidoscopeVariant::Crimson {
                            <Group class="kalei_tendril_group"
                                x=50%
                                y=50%
                                width=120%
                                height=120%
                                anchor=[0%, 50%]
                                rotate={(layer.rotation_deg * 0.8)deg}
                                scale={[(self._fold * 100)%, (self._coil * 100)%]}
                            >
                                <Tendril
                                    width=70%
                                    height=30%
                                    variant=KaleidoscopeVariant::Crimson
                                    playhead={self.playhead + layer.index * 120.0 + angle}
                                    seed={angle + (layer.index * 12.0)}
                                    opacity={layer.opacity}
                                />
                            </Group>
                        }
                        if self.enable_tendrils && self.variant == KaleidoscopeVariant::Nocturne {
                            <Group class="kalei_tendril_group"
                                x=50%
                                y=50%
                                width=120%
                                height=120%
                                anchor=[0%, 50%]
                                rotate={(layer.rotation_deg * 0.8)deg}

                                    playhead={self.playhead + layer.index * 120.0 + angle}
                                    seed={angle + (layer.index * 12.0)}
                                    opacity={layer.opacity}
                                />
                            </Group>
                        }
                        if self.enable_tendrils && self.variant == KaleidoscopeVariant::Lagoon {
                            <Group class="kalei_tendril_group"
                                x=50%
                                y=50%
                                width=120%
                                height=120%
                                anchor=[0%, 50%]
                                rotate={(layer.rotation_deg * 0.8)deg}
